about: Zone PLAN rows (World, Lead 2026-10-22): the greybox geometry any zone can carry, keyed by `zone`. `anchors` say where a zone's numbers hang (each `source` names a landmark, passage, zone width or rule value; `base` is its value when the rows were measured); each piece, awning, figure, brazier and mark is at its baseline with `follow` = field -> {anchor local name: weight}. origins/zones/plan.ts builds a Plan from these; the Concord Exchange is the first zone to carry one (tests/zone-plan.test.ts pins it to the frozen code oracle).
